panic.title: Panic / Police Mode
panic.desc: Select between 2 and 12 trigger inputs. When triggered, the scooter locks down and requires the recovery code below to reactivate.

speed.title: Top Speed
speed.desc: You can set up to 127 km/h. Actual speed is limited by your rider weight.

start.title: Start Speed
start.desc: Speed applied the moment you throttle from a stop.

modes.title: Mode Control
modes.desc: Set the maximum speed allowed within each ride mode.

wheelie.title: Wheelie Optimizer
wheelie.desc: Automatically balances power delivery to help you lift the front wheel and hold a stable wheelie.

soon.title: More coming soon
soon.desc: Additional premium tuning tools are in development and will unlock in a future update.

settings.title: Settings
settings.firmwareDesc: Region restrictions are bypassed automatically on every connection.
